items.headline: U.S. Destroys Five Iranian Oil Tankers After Missile Attacks on Navy Warship
items.summary: On September 8, United States Central Command disabled or destroyed five Iranian crude oil tankers in response to Iranian ballistic missile strikes targeted at an American warship. The military action marks a major escalation in Middle East maritime security that is driving global oil prices higher and heightening regional diplomatic tensions.

items.headline: US Security Agencies Accuse Chinese AI Firms of Mass Tech Extraction
items.summary: Three top US intelligence and security agencies issued a joint advisory accusing several Chinese tech companies of systematically extracting proprietary capabilities from leading American AI models. US officials allege that firms used unauthorized knowledge distillation on an industrial scale, marking a major escalation in international technology competition and cyber governance.

items.headline: Zheng Qinwen Stuns Iga Swiatek to Reach 2026 US Open Quarterfinals
items.summary: Olympic gold medalist Zheng Qinwen pulled off a major upset at the 2026 US Open by defeating top contender Iga Swiatek in the fourth round. The victory advances the Chinese tennis star into the quarterfinals at Flushing Meadows and dramatically reshapes the women's draw at the final Grand Slam of the year.

items.headline: Stevie Wonder Announces World Tour for 'Songs in the Key of Life' 50th Anniversary
items.summary: Stevie Wonder announced an 18-date international tour to celebrate the 50th anniversary of his landmark 1976 album, Songs in the Key of Life. The legendary musician will perform the acclaimed double album in its entirety across Europe and North America starting in October 2026.
